items.quote: I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people
items.claim: The LORD has observed the Israelites and characterizes them as stiffnecked

items.quote: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them
items.claim: The LORD's wrath may intensify against the people, and they may be consumed

items.quote: and I will make of thee a great nation
items.claim: The LORD will make Moses into a great nation
